# Purpose

The purpose of `grades_analysis.R` is to analyze a synthetic student grades dataset. The script summarizes student performance, calculates subject averages, identifies students who may be at risk of failing, and produces a visualization of average scores by subject.

# Required Packages

The script requires the following R packages:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Input

The script creates its own synthetic dataset using fictional student names and randomly generated grades. No external data files are required.

# Processing Steps

The script performs the following tasks:

1. Loads the required packages.
2. Creates a synthetic dataset of student grades.
3. Calculates summary statistics for each student.
4. Calculates average scores for each subject.
5. Identifies students whose average score is below 60.
6. Produces a bar chart showing average scores by subject.
7. Prints all results to the console.

# Main Code

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Create synthetic dataset
set.seed(42)

students <- c("Ava","Ben","Carlos","Dana","Elijah",
              "Fatima","Grace","Hiro","Isla","Jamal")

subjects <- c("Math","Science","English")

grades <- expand.grid(student = students,
                      subject = subjects) %>%
  mutate(score = round(rnorm(n(), mean = 75, sd = 12)),
         score = pmin(pmax(score,0),100))

student_summary <- grades %>%
  group_by(student) %>%
  summarise(
    average_score = round(mean(score),1),
    min_score = min(score),
    max_score = max(score)
  )

subject_summary <- grades %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(average_score = round(mean(score),1))

at_risk <- student_summary %>%
  filter(average_score < 60)

subject_plot <- ggplot(subject_summary,
                       aes(x = subject,
                           y = average_score,
                           fill = subject)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Average Score by Subject",
       x = "Subject",
       y = "Average Score") +
  theme_minimal()

student_summary
subject_summary
at_risk
subject_plot
```

# Outputs

The script produces:

- Student performance summary
- Subject performance summary
- List of at-risk students
- Bar chart of average score by subject

# Conclusion

This project demonstrates how R can be used to generate synthetic data, summarize information, identify students who may require additional support, and present results visually using `ggplot2`. The project also illustrates good documentation practices through R Markdown.
